messages:
sara-pm: Postmortem posted for Pegasus Dedicated outage. Need owners for follow-ups focused on VPC peering, on-prem router quirks, and isolation regression checks.

sara-pm: Root cause summary: on-prem maintenance left a stale route-map on customer edge that filtered Redwood prefixes; our peering agent retried but didn't trigger a re-advertise quickly enough.

leo_eng: I'll own the peering-agent change to force a reannounce on successful BGP session recovery. ETA: patch + canary by Fri EOD.

nima_sre: I'll add a synthetic check that queries RIBs from peers and alerts on prefix divergence > 20s. Will also add a grafana panel and an alert runbook. ETA: Mon AM.

olivia_support: I'll coordinate the customer-facing remediation steps and schedule a walkthrough with Pegasus networking. Need exact CLI snippets for Cisco ASR from SRE.

nima_sre: For Cisco ASR tidy commands: `show running-config | include prefix-list` and to clear and reannounce: `clear ip bgp * soft out` (include with caution). I'll paste a sanitized example to the shared runbook.

leo_eng: Opening ticket RDW-4599 for the agent change. Will add unit tests that simulate rapid session flaps.

sara-pm: Consolidated actions: 1) agent reannounce fix (owner: leo_eng, ETA: 2112351600) 2) runbook + walkthrough (owner: olivia_support, ETA: 2112355200) 3) synthetic RIB probe + dashboard (owner: nima_sre, ETA: 2112416000) 4) customer update email (owner: sara-pm, ETA: 2112349200).

incident-bot: Ticket RDW-4599 created and assigned to leo_eng.

leo_eng: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/peering-agent/pull/512. Starting Dedicated canary small shard now.

(8m later)

leo_eng: Canary looks good on first 10m window. No regressions. Promoting to wider Dedicated shard.

nima_sre: Probe live; dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/pegasus-peering. Alert RDW-ALERT-934 wired to paging if >1 host shows isolation in 24h.

olivia_support: Walkthrough scheduled with Pegasus networking for tomorrow 15:00 UTC. I'll include the sanitized CLI steps and runbook link.

sara-pm: Thanks team. We'll reconvene 72h after full rollout to confirm stability and then mark actions closed.
